verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a general integration platform — REST API, webhooks, OAuth, and SDKs (klaviyo-docs-1,klaviyo-docs-22,klaviyo-docs-31,klaviyo-docs-23) — that could support connecting to a product database or building custom links to Stripe/Shopify/Segment, but no evidence pack item names a maintained first-party Shopify, Stripe, or Segment integration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of first-party Shopify/Stripe connectors, a CDP (Segment) integration, and any partner/app marketplace listing confirming maintained status.
